accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

active_registration_exists.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP 0x811 supplied-balance slot

registration_pending.meaning: the BLP slot registration is in pending state rather than promoted
registration_pending.checkpoint: after the supplyToBlp call, before any suppliedBalance read

supplied_balance_read_succeeded.meaning: a suppliedBalance read for the BLP slot completed successfully

total_backing_signed_reverts_occurred.meaning: a later totalBackingSigned()/distributableSurplus()/settleDailyPnL() call reverts before removeSuppliedEntry clears the entry
total_backing_signed_reverts_occurred.checkpoint: after the supplyToBlp call, on a later strict backing/surplus read

assumptions: HyperCore activation of the 0x811 slot may be asynchronous, so a pending registration state is meaningful.
The later strict reads are performed while the entry has not yet been cleared by removeSuppliedEntry.

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify when HyperCore leaves the slot inactive or the timing window for asynchronous activation; the potential/conditional status of the revert is preserved only as a Boolean outcome.
Report does not state whether the caller performing supplyToBlp is authorized or privileged.

limitations: The revert of totalBackingSigned()/distributableSurplus()/settleDailyPnL() is encoded as a single Boolean outcome; the three functions are not distinguished individually.
The pending-then-promote ordering is represented by separate checkpoint Booleans rather than an explicit temporal_order relation because the selected class is progress_or_liveness.
The potential modality of the impact is preserved by treating the revert as a conditional forbidden failure rather than an inevitable effect.
